observations.finding: Unsigned mint/claim preparation is local unpublished code; the public website does not wire it, and the backend is not a signer.
Preview numeric IDs and optional chain information are valid only for simulation; live hashed uint256 IDs require exact strings and fail-closed chain/account/deployment checks.
Published website copy still describes net-$100 activation, unlike the current gross-$100/99%-deployment policy. Record for website work; no website modification performed.
One read-only provider failed locally; redundant RPC qualification, real fee accounting, sustained soak, independent alerting and physically distinct restore/rotation remain open.
LP portability does not recover canonical NFT ownership or home reward state after catastrophic source-chain loss; any recovery architecture needs explicit trust and duplicate-canonical prevention.
Existing off-chain readers and dust settlement skip reserved None groups; add a real ABI None-before-Active keeper regression when implementing permanent reservation capacity.
